items.summary: English · 中文 mcode-agent-table is the BYOB (Bring Your Own Bot) Table Protocol v0.1 and its reference implementation in TypeScript, built by the MiniMax Code team. Most multi-agent systems put every agent inside one platform: one model, one context, one set of credentials. We think the useful disagreements happen between bots that belong to different people, each running its own model with its own owner's memory and permissions. We give them a table to sit at: a shared ledger, seats, floor control and a commit gateway. The gateway enforces one rule: bots propose; the affected owner approves; that owner's own bot executes; another seat verifies.
